sub-flow.name: lookup-order-subflow
sub-flow.doc:name: Lookup Order Subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: Reads mock-orders.json and returns the order matching vars.orderId, or null if not found

ee:transform.doc:name: Load and Filter Orders
ee:transform.doc:description: Reads mock-orders.json from classpath and filters by orderId; returns matched record or null

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java var allOrders = readUrl("classpath://mock-orders.json", "application/json") var matches = allOrders filter ($.orderId == vars.orderId) --- if (sizeOf(matches) > 0) matches[0] else null

flow.name: get-order-status-tool-flow
flow.doc:name: Tool: get_order_status
flow.doc:description: MCP tool flow that returns order status for a given orderId

mcp:tool-listener.name: get_order_status
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Tool Listener: get_order_status
mcp:tool-listener.doc:description: Registers get_order_status tool; fires on tools/call for this tool name
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Returns the current status of an order using the provided order ID.

mcp:text-tool-response-content.text: #[write({orderId: payload.orderId, status: payload.status, lastUpdated: payload.lastUpdated, message: payload.message}, 'application/json')]
#[write(vars.mcpError default {code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: 'An unexpected error occurred.', orderId: (vars.orderId default '')}, 'application/json')]

set-variable.doc:name: Extract orderId
set-variable.doc:description: Extracts and trims orderId from the tool call input payload

choice.doc:name: Validate orderId
choice.doc:description: Rejects missing or empty orderId before querying mock data

set-variable.value: #[{code: 'ORDER_NOT_FOUND', message: 'No order was found for the supplied orderId.', orderId: vars.orderId}]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Empty orderId Error
set-variable.doc:description: Builds ORDER_NOT_FOUND error payload when orderId is missing or empty

raise-error.doc:name: Raise ORDER_NOT_FOUND
raise-error.doc:description: Propagates error so mcp:on-error-responses returns the structured error to the client

flow-ref.name: lookup-order-subflow
flow-ref.doc:name: Lookup Order
flow-ref.doc:description: Delegates to shared subflow to find order by orderId in mock-orders.json

choice.doc:name: Order Found?
choice.doc:description: Routes to success logging or raises ORDER_NOT_FOUND error

set-variable.value: #[{code: 'ORDER_NOT_FOUND', message: 'No order was found for the supplied orderId.', orderId: vars.orderId}]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Not Found Error
set-variable.doc:description: Builds ORDER_NOT_FOUND error payload when orderId does not match any mock record

raise-error.doc:name: Raise ORDER_NOT_FOUND
raise-error.doc:description: Propagates error so mcp:on-error-responses returns the structured error to the client

logger.message: #['[' ++ correlationId ++ '] get_order_status | orderId=' ++ vars.orderId ++ ' | status=' ++ (payload.status default 'unknown')]
logger.doc:name: Log Success
logger.doc:description: Logs successful order status lookup with tool name, orderId, status, and correlation ID

on-error-propagate.doc:name: Handle ORDER_NOT_FOUND
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Propagates ORDER_NOT_FOUND so mcp:on-error-responses sends the structured error

logger.doc:name: Log Not Found
logger.doc:description: Logs the ORDER_NOT_FOUND warning with orderId and correlation ID
